rounds.text: Manaksia Ltd trades at a remarkably low valuation when benchmarked against its sector, offering a P/E ratio of just 6.93x compared to the sector benchmark of 35.78x [E6]. This profound disconnect is further underscored by a price-to-book ratio of 0.51x against a sector benchmark of 3.77x [E7]. The company demonstrates solid operational efficiency, generating a positive Return on Assets of 6.14% while the sector benchmark sits at a staggering -171.35% [E8]. Furthermore, the company's historical earnings power is proven by a median Return on Equity of 19% over a 10-year period and 16% over a 5-year period [E26, E27]. Conceded: the current Return on Equity has compressed to 3.1% and the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4, E13]. Nevertheless, with the stock resting only 38% of the way up its 52-week range at a market capitalisation of ₹ 377 Cr, the current pricing fails to reflect these historical returns and sector-relative valuation discounts [E3, E5].
